conflicts_in.fact: Kabete tunnel dimension used (width/opening vs length)
conflicts_in.versions: Lessons 1, 5, 6, 12 use tunnel width/opening ~8 m. Lesson 9 overview/explain use ~8 m, but its model-building teacher script uses a 4 m tunnel mouth. Lesson 11 uses a tunnel length of ~120 m for resonance.

conflicts_in.fact: Lesson numbering of diffraction and wave-equation topics / lesson sequence cross-references
conflicts_in.versions: Lesson 3 and Lesson 5 both teach v = fλ in full (Classic 105 and KBC AM calculations duplicated). Lesson 8 says the antenna thread is completed in Lesson 10, but Lesson 10 is refraction/TIR. Lesson 11 says diffraction was Lesson 10 and interference was Lesson 10, whereas diffraction is Lesson 6 (and 9) and interference is Lesson 7.

conflicts_in.fact: Why FM fades in the tunnel
conflicts_in.versions: Lessons 6 and 12 explain it as limited diffraction because FM λ is small compared with the tunnel opening. Lesson 10 attributes it to total internal reflection/refraction at tunnel walls, which is inappropriate for the tunnel/radio case (FM wave described as TIR-trapped in the tunnel).

conflicts_in.fact: Whether AM or FM undergoes standing waves/interference in the tunnel
conflicts_in.versions: Lesson 9 says reflected AM waves create constructive interference over wide zones; Lesson 11 says AM cannot form any standing wave in the tunnel (wavelength >> 120 m tunnel). Lesson 11 also says FM resonance in tunnel may reinforce, versus Lessons 7/9 treating reflections as destructive dead-zones.
